definition: The feeling of being upset or annoyed as a result of being unable to change something.
exampleSentence: She expressed deep frustration that her colleagues would not cooperate.

definition: A hope or ambition of achieving something.
exampleSentence: If only my practical skills matched my artistic aspirations.

definition: Not carried out or brought to completion.
exampleSentence: I wish that our collaborative goals had not remained unfulfilled.

definition: A real or imagined cause for complaint, especially unfair treatment.
exampleSentence: Employees wished management had addressed their grievances much sooner.

definition: To set right an undesirable situation.
exampleSentence: If only we could remedy the communication gap between the two teams.
